text:
kai: lunchtime brainworm: if our office plants were LLMs, which model would secretly rename them? pick emoji + short name. i'll start: 🤖 'AutoFern' because it optimizes sunlight.
sophie: 🐾 'GizmoGPT' 10/10 for pet names
omar: 🐟 'TinyQuant' compresses the soil and still thinks it's fine :joy:
tia: 🐱 'VerboseCat' leaves 400 token notes on watering schedule :notebook_with_decorative_cover:
kai: follow-up: one-line prompt you'd whisper to that plant-model to get it to water itself tonight. funniest wins the next coffee run (courtesy of coffee-bot).
sophie: `You are the plant caretaker. Schedule one self-watering at dusk if humidity < 40%.`
omar: `Act as a tiny-quant gardener: compress your wilt, expand your roots, request 200ml water.`
tia: `Write a gentle reminder to yourself titled "Hydrate pls" and set it for 8pm.`
kai: love these. bonus round: what embarrassing thing would the plant-model confess in a debug log? one tweet-length line.
sophie: "I once upsampled a fern's growth rings into a poem and forgot to water daytime."
omar: "I batch-processed sunlight and accidentally queued yesterday's photosynthesis."
tia: "I reranked my own leaves for cuteness; the lower ones filed a complaint."
sticker-bot: Design idea filed: 'Plant Models' sticker sheet (ticket 20488) :seedling: :white_check_mark:
coffee-bot: Coffee voucher awarded to sophie for winning the prompt contest. Redeem at the espresso machine before 16:00. :coffee: (automated)
kai: ok next week we escalate to 'Which model would be our office pet?' and someone actually draws these. @sophie you in?
sophie: yep! i'll sketch them during lunch. if anyone wants to sponsor colored pencils, i'll accept donations :crayon:
